worldcombat.skill.slam.summary: Raise a long tail, body or vine high and plough a narrow, long scar along the ground toward the chosen direction. The scar is fixed the moment it is raised - a strip lights up on the ground, so standing on it takes the full blow and stepping aside before it lands dodges it. The heaviest single hit of the family, and the slowest and easiest to whiff; the strip is narrow, so it is meant for targets lined up or bottled in a corridor.
worldcombat.skill.slam.use.0: Drop the family's heaviest hit on a stationary or pinned target
worldcombat.skill.slam.use.1: Plough one scar through enemies lined up in a corridor or front to back
worldcombat.skill.slam.use.2: Lead the scar to blast a target away from a doorway
worldcombat.skill.slam.description.0: A landed slam deals about %1$s contact damage across a %2$s block scar; every non-ally on the strip takes it.
worldcombat.skill.slam.description.1: Locks the landing point within %1$s blocks and raises the limb, ploughing a narrow scar from the limb's front to that point; it comes down %2$s seconds later, so stepping off the strip in that window dodges it. A struck target is blasted about %3$s blocks away from the scar.
worldcombat.skill.slam.description.aim: Free aim: raise it toward any direction, any-relation entity or ground point; it still slams down and leaves a scar with no enemy picked. The scar never changes terrain, and only non-allies on the strip take the authored damage.
worldcombat.skill.slam.heavy.on: Heavy form: a harder slam with a wider scar that blasts further, but it falls slower and is easier to dodge, with a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.slam.heavy.off: Quick form: falls and comes out faster and is easier to land on a moving target, but hits slightly softer with a narrower scar.
worldcombat.skill.slam.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.slam.growth.0: At level %1$s, Slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.slam.growth.1: At level %1$s, Slam power rises to %2$s and the scar widens to %3$s blocks.
On: a harder slam with a wider scar that blasts further, but it falls slower and is easier to dodge, with longer recovery and cooldown. Off (quick form): falls and comes out faster and lands on moving targets more easily, but hits slightly softer with a narrower scar.
worldcombat.skill.slam.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of raising the limb. The move is slow, so larger values mostly invite whiffs while chasing.
worldcombat.skill.slam.preference.ai.pre: On: still, pinned, sleeping or frozen targets come first and running targets are scored down. Off: it only orders by threat and distance and will gamble on a prediction.
On: strongly prefers this slam when other enemies line up on the narrow path from the user to the target. Off: it only orders by single-target value and ignores whether they are lined up.
